candidates.excerpt: The six stations where entry and exit will remain closed are Patel Chowk, Janpath, Rajiv Chowk, Mandi House, Central Secretariat and Barakhamba Road

candidates.title: Rahul urges citizens to join INDIA bloc march to Supreme Court ‘as Indians’, irrespective of party affiliations
candidates.excerpt: Congress chief accuses PM and HM of “imposing an undeclared emergency”; party leader K.C. Venugopal is coordinating with INDIA bloc parties regarding Monday’s march though the plan is not public yet
